positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Technical lead on the infrastructure services team
Design and build dynamic infrastructure as code, as well as tooling to support updating configuration
Design and build automation processes to support developer workflow needs around testing and deploying code
Implement and maintain GitOps style framework with modern, open-source tooling
Provide guidance on technical decisions and implementations

positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.description:
WLAN infrastructure analysis, deployment, and troubleshooting
Deployment and management of internally hosted tools such as ScreenConnect and AD SelfService Plus
Management of software and service accounts such as Enterprise Box, Google Admin, and Cloudastructure
Global collaboration with IT teams at medical facilities across the country, as well as partners in India and Bangladesh
Management of VMWare virtual desktop environment (Gold Pattern modification, pool management, etc)

positions.title: Junior Network Administrator
positions.description:
Management of IT ticket system including calls and emails
Setup and manage Cisco IP pone system
Maintain the mobile device deployment via VMWare Airwatch
Projects such as creating Access forms for the company Intranet
